text:
I can't see the meal after eating, so the leftover figure is a guess. I assumed the person eats nearly everything and leaves about 5% uneaten.

Estimated servings:
- Cereal, about 40 g of a honey-style multigrain cereal: ~150 kcal, 3 g protein, 31 g carbs, 2 g fat.
- Milk, about 200 ml of whole milk in the bottle: ~125 kcal, 6.5 g protein, 9.5 g carbs, 6.5 g fat.
- Fried or poached egg: ~90 kcal, 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Toast, one slice of white bread: ~90 kcal, 3 g protein, 17 g carbs, 1 g fat.
- Butter portion, about 7 g: ~50 kcal, 0 g protein, 0 g carbs, 5.5 g fat.

Together the served meal is about 505 kcal. Assuming ~25 kcal is left over, the person eats about 480 kcal.

For the amount eaten, I scaled the totals down to match: about 18 g protein, 56 g carbs and 20 g fat.
